findings.element: Shopify stores · My ceramic plates card in 'Ready' state while Sync is Disabled
findings.finding: Once the store is Ready, the only remaining numbered step on the card is the optional '1 item needs mapping · Map products', and nothing on the card or page points to Enable — the alert that said 'After that, click Enable' disappeared at the first connect.
findings.user_impact: Users read 'Ready' plus a numbered step as the remaining job, go map products and believe they are done while sync stays Disabled (the KF-2 'imported = done' drop-off pattern).
findings.suggested_fix: When a store is Ready and sync is Disabled, show a next-step row or keep the info alert saying 'Click Enable in Sync to start sending stock changes', and drop the step number from the non-blocking mapping row.

evidence.action: State 1: connect My ceramic plates, Choose location → Save, Open Settings.
evidence.observed: Card reads 'Ready … Mappings: 4/5 · 1 · 1 item needs mapping · Map products'; no info alert is present any more; Sync block in a separate column still shows 'State: Disabled · Enable' with no reference from the card.

findings.element: Activity tab · Held row (Reason 'Item not matched', Actions '–') and Retry held and failed
findings.finding: A Held event shows the reason 'Item not matched' but offers no action or link to fix it, and Retry only answers 'Nothing was sent: fix the reason first.' without saying where the fix is made.
findings.user_impact: A user reviewing what was sent hits a dead end on the Held row and has to guess that the fix lives on the Mappings tab (which uses a different word, 'Not mapped').
findings.suggested_fix: Give the Held row an action such as 'Map item' that opens the Mappings tab filtered to that store and product, and name the fix location in the Retry toast.

evidence.action: State 2: click Held count on Overview → Activity filtered Held; click 'Retry 1 held'.
evidence.observed: Row 'Oct 1, 2026 16:59 · My ceramic plates · Bill #1045 · Plate seconds (B-grade) · – · +12 · Held · Item not matched · –'; toast 'Nothing was sent: fix the reason first.'

findings.element: Activity tab · table row order (All stores)
findings.finding: With All stores selected the rows are grouped by store instead of sorted by Time, so the list jumps 16:58 → 15:20 → 11:05 → 14:40 → 12:15.
findings.user_impact: Users checking what was sent and when misread the sequence of stock changes and may miss the latest event or think events are missing.
findings.suggested_fix: Sort the Activity table by Time descending across all stores by default (as it already is in State 2 after a revert).

evidence.action: State 3: open the Activity tab with Store = All stores and no Status filter.

findings.element: 'Don't see your store here?' help — Connect store dialog vs Overview Shopify stores footer
findings.finding: The same recovery step points to two different places: the dialog says 'Add it first in Settings › Add integration' while the Overview footer says 'Connect it first in Organization settings'.
findings.user_impact: A user whose store is missing gets conflicting directions and may search the wrong settings area or give up on connecting the store.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one destination and one wording in both places, ideally as the same link.

evidence.action: State 1: read the Overview Shopify stores footer, then open Connect store from the Stock check tab alert.
evidence.observed: Overview: 'Don't see your store here? Connect it first in Organization settings'; dialog: 'Don't see your store here? Add it first in Settings › Add integration.'
